goal: Users can search, page, refresh, and open repository branches and pull requests, then inspect their real pipeline history without unsupported Forge metadata or mutations.
non_goals: Do not edit API types/endpoints, backend, router, RepoWrapper, PipelineList, pipeline store, manual-run, repository settings, permission calculation, dependency, or approved-prototype files.
Do not add branch protection, ahead/behind, comparison, deletion, PR creation, author/source/target/review/comment/diff metadata, or Forge write actions.
Do not fabricate server totals or imply that the injected recent pipeline collection is complete.
expected_evidence: Focused pure-function and route-component tests proving PR ref normalization, branch/PR search, refresh, pagination, explicit states, exact correlation, and detail navigation.
Full frontend Vitest plus targeted Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite build, and git diff receipts.
Current desktop and 390px browser evidence for populated branch/PR list and detail states without page-level horizontal overflow.
Evidence-bearing task report plus independent spec and quality reviews for baseline task 4.2.
unsafe_assumptions: Branch APIs expose only names and PR APIs expose only index/title; all richer prototype metadata is unsupported.
Pipeline enrichment is limited to already-loaded real repository pipelines and can be absent.
PR ref normalization supports only the formats already handled by current production code.
Loaded counts are not authoritative server totals.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation needs richer API fields, a new request or mutation, route/store/RepoWrapper/PipelineList/manual-run change, a new permission rule, approved-prototype edit, or fabricated branch/PR metadata.
